name: @multica/ios
description: Multica iOS — native SwiftUI client for the Multica platform.

scripts.build: pnpm run generate && xcodebuild -project Multica.xcodeproj -scheme Multica -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -configuration Debug build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.build:device: pnpm run generate && xcodebuild -project Multica.xcodeproj -scheme Multica -destination 'platform=iOS,id=00008140-000265DC20E3C01C' -configuration Debug -allowProvisioningUpdates -derivedDataPath build/ build
scripts.test: pnpm run generate && xcodebuild test -project Multica.xcodeproj -scheme Multica -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -quiet CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
